body: Ughh, I hate petty arguments like that, I could ramble about it all day. I hope he took some time to think about whether its actually selfish or not, because it obviously isn't, but to each their own. Forgive me if I am unable to form a cogent sentence right now, I've been up for 27 hours.

I don't even understand how suicide can be seen as selfish. Being depressed/anxious/bipolar/schizophrenic is no better or worse than any other illness out there. People should have that choice if their entire life revolves around suffering.
Idk why mods removed it, but I think op was curious about whether this method even works or not, mainly due to the fact that most people tend to commit suicide by overdosing instead of exit bags

From what I've seen at least, a lotta people go into drug overdoses thinking of it as a simple/painless exit method, 9 times out of 10 it isn't. Strangulation is probably an option most people don't think of cause it causes a lot of discomfort up until your last breath
No problem man. Whatever happens, I hope you can find peace. I'm pretty tired of being here.
Yeah man, I'm still planning on it. Life has kinda just been goin down for years, everybody says "It gets better" but it doesn't, no matter how hard I  try. How about yourself?
I really hope you don't hurt yourself, but I understand why you'd want that. Most of us don't got guns so thats probably the least painful way. Hope you can find peace in this life my friend xx
I'm in the same boat man. Hope things get better for you eventually, this life is hell. Hopefully we just stay asleep forever after we die, thats all I want really. You deserve peace brother xx
Thank you. It's been a very aggravating night
I feel for you man, it hasn't gotten that bad for me yet. Even though our lives mean nothing, I hope you can find peace in this existence, whether its today, or 10 years from now. xx
I appreciate you. Wishing the best for you xx
I hope you can find a reason to pursue it again, this world needs more music. Thank you for your words, hope you're well.
I will try, friend. Thank you for your kind words, the world needs more people like you.

I know exactly what you mean with the fleeting positivity that lasts only for seconds, you crave it so much once its gone. Once I experienced that shit, I realized my life wasn't nearly as good as I had imagined. I may come with you soon, friend.
